source_spans.exact_quote: You also must be very very careful, as your generalization of the goals is changing the actual semantics of what your true purpose is. For instance, you state; "restoration of zodiacal/Ophiuchus orientation" which is not something that was ever articulated in that way before, threatens to approach the problem in an incorrect manner, as it is not necessarily our position that Ophiuchus belongs as a member of a 12 unit zodiac system explicitly, but rather that while it way indeed has ever been intended to be considered at all among them, perhaps it was merely in an implicit manner, or perhaps it is only to be considered symbolically, or perhaps it is to be counted but in  a manner that does not result in a geometric change like it may were it to be counted as part of the pie.  In a similar manner, the three goals stated prior to the Ophiuchus example were all three similarly mis-articulated in a way that your new semantics that accompanies them threatens to change your actual purpose.

The main purpose centers around several hypothesis', which we are to be testing from multiple directions. The purpose of having you reconstruct the history of the investigation is due to the severe inefficiencies and misalignments between the models assisting in the investigation and myself, and the core thought being that either me or the model may have stated something crucial that was not carried correctly, considered correctly, or handled correctly, and among those bypassed crucial points might be something that solves many of our issues. As an example, it was probably about 10+ times it occurred that I had to remind the models of prior discoveries and decisions surrounding the simultaneous utilization of Western and Chinese music along with the Completed Harmony bridge to the Tree of Life (TOL) adapter, which often messed things up because I needed help discerning when the bridge was to be considered and utilized and when it should be held aside and used for testing a new theory. So the thought here was that if you could trace everything from before many of our systems and nomenclature were formalized, you may discover crucial omissions in later work, or things we did not carry that we should have, or conversely discover that we carried things we shouldn't have. Maybe this reconstruction effort should have been something that was sandboxed and run in parallel, because it is NOT the sole purpose of your assignment, but rather just an attempt to ensure that you started from a more secure place with stronger footing than we have thus far.

A meta-goal that could be considered that was not necessarily explicitly stated is that you are meant to formalize system hierarchies for every system that we have established, from eastern and western music, to other musical systems that remain participatory candidates, to cosmological and cosmogonical traditions (always erring towards the oldest recorded accounts,) to biblical characters and their respective timelines, to zodiacal systems, to mathematical systems, scientific systems, color scales, DNA and biological systems, esoteric systems (sefer yetzira, shem ha memphoresh, trees of life in various cosmologies, Yggdrasil, etc.,) alphabets, number systems (like how the number 0 is a more recent inclusion in how we do math) etc., seeing how everything aligns, where things diverge, and how things are all fit together, when utilizing a common geometric structure for their representations which would highlight precisely where and how things diverge, since it has been our working theory that it is aligning all of these systems within a common structure is what will enable further deterministic predictions.

Two of the more explicitly stated over arching goals of this entire assignment are to rectify the correct date/time from various historical perspectives by imagining them in various combinations of being unbroken from their institutional use, as well as only being affected by specific other calendar system changes throughout time, and more importantly to rectify the correct representation and phonetic transmission of the sacred symbols as they were originally intended. It has been viewed as among the first major hurdles that when correctly solved, will result in a cascade of everything else coming into clear focus, and rectifying the majority of misalignments and open questions that we would have. There will be several ways to approach exploring and testing theories as to what the correct alphabetical system with the correct intended sounds truly is. Here are a few points;

I believe that while the majority of these points are mostly useful as negative examples, there are potentially a few that can truly lead us in the right direction. We have established that it will most likely be in the proper comparison of the specific sounds attached to the specific symbols of Paleo-Hebrew, Aramaic, English, Greek, Latin, (particularly the first 3) that will lead to the correct system, and allow us to decode the true messages secreted into the bible's chapters and verses. This, I believe could potentially allow us to faithfully trace intended genealogy from Adam throughout the entire bible, and even potentially past through to the modern day through a few specific bloodlines and other causal inferences, but we'll address that if and when relevant.
